title: Remove Native Algorithm Adapters
description: Remove all native adapters from semio/algorithms. The new architecture uses semio/rs as the single source of truth and re-exports it through semio/js, semio/react, and semio/ui. Refactor existing files and tests without legacy support.
summary: Removed the remaining native-adapter surface from semio/algorithms by deleting the ignored native bridge sources and language decorator file from the workspace, keeping Storybook on the rs-backed @semio/js/@semio/react/@semio/ui path. Fixed algorithms Storybook imports to use @storybook/react-vite, adjusted the embedded public-surface guard to use import.meta.vitest, and added tsconfig aliases/types needed by the rs WASM re-export path. Verification: npx tsc --noEmit -p semio/algorithms/tsconfig.json passed; npm --workspace @semio/algorithms run lint passed; npm --workspace @semio/algorithms run test passed with the package's no-test-files configuration; npm --workspace @semio/algorithms run build completed successfully with existing Vite/docgen warnings.
